title: VC-Dimension and Generalization in Geometric Machine Learning with Applications to Active Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We compute the VC-dimension of metric ball classifiers in the model spaces of Riemannian geometry (Euclidean, spherical, hyperbolic) and present upper and lower bounds on the VC-dimension of metric balls in several other situations, including general normed vector spaces (potentially infinite VC-dimension), vector spaces with $\ell^p$-norms (VC-dimension grows at least linearly in the dimension, faster than Euclidean for $p=1$), flat tori, and general Riemannian manifolds (arbitrarily large VC-dimension after a conformal change). In several situations where the VC-dimension is large or even infinite, we prove generalization bounds under additional assumptions on the data distribution using covering arguments. Both in the VC-dimension and covering setting, we consider data on low-dimensional subsets of high-dimensional Euclidean spaces. As an application, we consider coverage-based algorithms in active learning.

translated_title: 几何机器学习中的VC维与泛化及其在主动学习中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们计算了黎曼几何模型空间（欧几里得空间、球面、双曲空间）中度量球分类器的VC维，并在多种其他情形下给出了度量球VC维的上界与下界，包括一般的赋范向量空间（VC维可能为无穷大）、具有 $\ell^p$ 范数的向量空间（VC维至少随维度线性增长，当 $p=1$ 时增长速度快于欧几里得情形）、平坦环面，以及一般的黎曼流形（在共形变换后VC维可以任意大）。在VC维很大甚至为无穷的若干情形下，我们利用覆盖论证，在附加的数据分布假设下证明了泛化界。无论是在VC维还是覆盖的设定中，我们都考虑了位于高维欧几里得空间低维子集上的数据。作为应用，我们研究了主动学习中基于覆盖的算法。
tldr: 该论文计算了黎曼几何模型空间中度量球分类器的VC维并给出了多种情形下的上下界，进而在数据分布假设下利用覆盖论证证明了泛化界，并将其应用于主动学习中的基于覆盖的算法。
en_tdlr: This paper computes the VC-dimension of metric ball classifiers in Riemannian model spaces (Euclidean, spherical, hyperbolic), establishes upper and lower bounds in various settings, proves generalization bounds via covering arguments, and applies these results to coverage-based algorithms in active learning.
